name: Vapin Ape Full Spectrum Disposable | Candy Fumez
description:
Candy Fumez is a hybrid cannabis strain known for a flavor profile that combines notes of sugary candy, mixed berries, and pungent diesel. This combination creates a complex aroma often described as both sweet and gassy. 

The terpene profile typically includes Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Linalool. Common reported effects associated with this strain include a sense of euphoria, creative stimulation, and physical relaxation. 

Taste & Aroma: Sugary Candy, Sweet Berries, Pungent Gas. Effects: Euphoric, Creative, Relaxing
